## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -16.56% | 1M: -16.75%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND and SPY (1W: +5.35% | 1M: +5.14%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND confirm risk appetite; HYG (1W: +0.98% | 1M: +2.13%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND adds credit confirmation.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress EASING: HYG (1W: +0.98% | 1M: +2.13%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +2.09%) ABOVE TREND are positive. Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -16.56% | 1M: -16.75%) BELOW TREND; Stocks vs Bonds skew supportive: SPY (1W: +5.35% | 1M: +5.14%) ABOVE TREND vs TLT (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +1.18%) ABOVE TREND → SPY/TLT ↑ rising.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-easing financial conditions: Dollar (1W: -0.76% | 1M: -1.48%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND and Yield Curve (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +0.24%) → flat ABOVE TREND, while TLT (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +1.18%) ABOVE TREND shows modest bond stability.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech leading with XLK (1W: +7.65% | 1M: +8.28%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +15.38% | 1M: +21.18%) ABOVE TREND; Financials also strong: XLF (1W: +5.06% | 1M: +9.97%) ABOVE TREND. Energy weak: XLE (1W: -7.00% | 1M: -2.40%) BELOW TREND. Style: Growth/momentum showing strength.

**5. US vs Global?**
US and EM both outperforming: SPY (1W: +5.35% | 1M: +5.14%) ABOVE TREND and EEM (1W: +8.60% | 1M: +9.58%) ABOVE TREND; China represented by FXI (1W: +3.97% | 1M: +1.79%) ABOVE TREND but China-tech ratios are softer, signaling narrower leadership.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation elevated: ARKK (1W: +8.83% | 1M: +6.52%) ABOVE TREND, IBIT (1W: +7.75% | 1M: +4.36%) ABOVE TREND and ETHA (1W: +9.66% | 1M: +10.07%) ABOVE TREND all showing risk-on flows; Speculation Index (1W: +3.53% | 1M: -0.22%) ↑ rising in RECOVERY.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Reflation metals leadership: CPER (1W: +9.33% | 1M: +7.01%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +9.25% | 1M: -0.89%) RECOVERY. Gold mixed on profit-taking: GLD (1W: +3.08% | 1M: -3.42%) RECOVERY.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy under pressure: XLE (1W: -7.00% | 1M: -2.40%) BELOW TREND, BNO (1W: -11.23% | 1M: -3.12%) BELOW TREND and UNG (1W: -8.57% | 1M: -16.46%) BELOW TREND all weak.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Broad equity advance with SPY (1W: +5.35% | 1M: +5.14%), QQQ (1W: +6.80% | 1M: +6.01%) and IWM (1W: +6.25% | 1M: +9.17%) all ABOVE TREND; semis leadership clear via SOXX (1W: +15.38% | 1M: +21.18%) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: Energy complex (USO/UGA in CORRECTION; XLE/BNO BELOW TREND) is the primary weakness — minor divergence overall given 9/11 breadth.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor tech and semiconductors (XLK, SOXX) and EM cyclicals (EEM); reduce exposure to energy ETFs (XLE, BNO) and monitor commodity-driven divergences. Bonds neutral — watch TLT (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +1.18%) ABOVE TREND for duration signals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Semis/Tech — SOXX (1W: +15.38% | 1M: +21.18%) ABOVE TREND; Consumer Discretionary — XLY proxy strength (Consumer Disc. 1W: +6.26% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Energy — XLE (1W: -7.00% | 1M: -2.40%) BELOW TREND; Commodities-linked oil ETFs — BNO (1W: -11.23% | 1M: -3.12%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Copper — CPER (1W: +9.33% | 1M: +7.01%) ABOVE TREND and silver SLV (1W: +9.25% | 1M: -0.89%) RECOVERY. BEARISH: Oil and gas — BNO (1W: -11.23% | 1M: -3.12%) BELOW TREND and UNG (1W: -8.57% | 1M: -16.46%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 — VXX (1W: -16.56% | 1M: -16.75%) BELOW TREND signals low fear if sustained. HYG/LQD around 0.73–0.75 — HYG (1W: +0.98% | 1M: +2.13%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +2.09%) ABOVE TREND mark credit health. XLK/XLF spread — XLK (1W: +7.65% | 1M: +8.28%) ABOVE TREND vs XLF (1W: +5.06% | 1M: +9.97%) ABOVE TREND for growth vs value pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive, VXX falling and SPY ABOVE TREND confirm broad risk appetite. Tech/semis and EM cyclicals showing strength while the energy complex shows the key divergence to monitor.
